lines.t: Behold, you will hear, and at once you shall speak
As God, you shall speak to them
Yes, you shall open your mouths to speak
And at the first word proceeding from your lips
They shall all be pushed backward
For as the mighty wound uproots and destroys
Tearing all in its path to pieces
So also shall the words of my witnesses be
A swelling wind to break the branches
A swelling wind to topple the trees
Until every root is laid bare and every foundation is swept clean
Until a deep burning will rise within the fallen
Then they shall stand up with renewed vigor
And come against you in haste with great violence and hate
And all they bring forth against you
Shall be turned back upon their own heads
And in the midst of their rage they shall be assaulted
As one who has stumbled upon a hornet's nest
Scattering them in fear for I am God
And my word never returns void
Behold, my word shall go out
And the harvest shall come in
The rest left, to the fire, to the singeing of all these hardened foreheads, says the Lord
Behold, my witnesses shall speak my name in power and perform many signs
And upon the lips of my elect It shall be for a song as in the days of
old And among my saints it shall be murmured
softly in prayer Offered up continually as a sweet-smelling
and savor, for I am the Lord and there is no other, I'm just God and the Savior, there
is none besides me.
Thank you.
Thank you.
